stem:
Asha hears two bells: one every $4$ minutes and one every $6$ minutes. They ring together at $9{:}00$. She wants the next time they ring together.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Name any common multiple such as $24$ minutes, skipping that the earliest common ring is the LCM.
Replace the common-multiple question with a full prime-factor write-up used only to name an HCF.
The first common ring is after $\operatorname{lcm}(4,6)=12$ minutes, so at $9{:}12$.
Choose $4$ minutes only because the printed number $4$ stands out in the stem.

teacher.key_rationale: The earliest common call-out is the LCM of the step sizes: $\operatorname{lcm}(4,6)=12$. Taking a later common multiple, switching to an HCF-only method, or grabbing the printed $4$ all miss that hinge.
